data.title: 莲华 · 古旧书库深处的纸卷寻踪
data.description: 旅馆深处的藏书楼尘封已久。莲华身着大正紫袴踩在高高的木梯上，从最顶层的书架抽出一卷古籍。她居高临下地垂眸望来，发梢垂落在纤细的腰际，充满书卷与神秘气韵。
data.location: lofty historic Japanese archive with towering cedar bookshelves and dust-mote beams
data.action: perched gracefully on rolling wooden ladder, pulling vintage scroll from top shelf, gazing down with haughty calm aristocratic elegance
data.lighting: shafts of amber afternoon sun piercing tall lattice windows illuminating leather tomes
data.mood: Taisho-era scholarly romance, cool haughty nobility, enigmatic intellectual beauty
data.promptProse: Standing on a library ladder in purple hakama, Renge looks down with cool aristocratic charm while holding a dusty antique scroll.
data.animaCaption: Renge perched on a rolling library ladder in Taisho hakama, examining ancient scrolls.
